Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with evidence for severe insulin resistance or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance must meet all of the following criteria: Suspected severe insulin resistance, or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance, as evidenced by one or more of the following: Hyperinsulinemia (i.e. fasting insulin >30microU/mL), High insulin requirement (> 2 units per kg per day or > 200 units total per day), Phenotypic features suggesting a defect in glucose/lipid metabolism: Acanthosis nigricans, Lipodystrophy/abnormal fat distribution, Xanthomata, Fatty liver, Known or suspected mutations of the insulin receptor gene, Known or suspected autoantibodies to the insulin receptor
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has type 2 diabetes mellitus and a heterozygous LDLR c.1444G>A mutation (familial hypercholesterolemia), but there is no evidence of hyperinsulinemia, high insulin requirement, or phenotypic features (e.g., acanthosis nigricans, lipodystrophy) associated with severe insulin resistance. The LDLR mutation is unrelated to insulin receptor gene mutations or autoantibodies.
The patient is 58 years old, which satisfies the age requirement.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Ability of subject or Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Family members of patients, above (either affected or unaffected) must meet all of the following criteria: Biological relatives of patients in category (1) in whom a genetic cause of insulin resistance is known or suspected
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not a family member of another patient in category (1); they are the primary patient with familial hypercholesterolemia, not insulin resistance.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 must meet all of the following criteria: In good general health with no known active medical conditions as evidenced by medical history
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has type 2 diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, coronary artery disease, and a history of myocardial infarctions, which disqualify them from being a healthy control.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2. Subjects from Cohort 1 may be included in Cohort 2 if they meet the following ADDITIONAL inclusion criteria: Fasting glucose <100 mg/dL, HbA1c <5.7%, Fasting triglycerides <150 mg/dL, Fasting insulin <30 mcU/mL, BMI <27 kg/m2 or <90th percentile for age/sex (whichever is lower)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has HbA1c levels between 6.5% and 7.2%, which exceed the 5.7% threshold for Cohort 2. Fasting glucose, triglycerides, insulin, and BMI data are not provided, but the HbA1c alone disqualifies them.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with evidence for insulin resistance or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance --none
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No exclusion criteria apply to this category.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Family members of patients, above --Pregnant at the time of enrollment
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is male and not a family member of a patient in category (1).

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - Current use of prescription or non-prescription medication. Certain exceptions are permitted, including topical medications, vitamins, and hormonal contraceptives. Other medications may be permitted at the discretion of the investigators
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is currently managed with metformin for type 2 diabetes, which is a prescription medication not explicitly permitted as an exception for Cohort 1.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - Recent (past 2 months) use of drugs or supplements that alter glucose or lipid metabolism (e.g. niacin, fish oil, red yeast rice)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's medication history in the past 2 months is not specified, so compliance cannot be verified.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - History of diabetes or abnormal glucose tolerance
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a documented history of type 2 diabetes mellitus, which explicitly violates this criterion.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - Psychiatric or cognitive disorder that will, in the opinion of the investigators, limit the subject's ability to provide informed consent/assent, or to comply with study procedures
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not a healthy control subject and has no documented psychiatric or cognitive disorders.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - Pregnant or lactating
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is male and not a healthy control subject.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2 - Abnormal screening labs, including the following: ALT or AST more than 1.5 times the upper limit of normal, Glycosuria, Clinically significant anemia, Low eGFR (<60 mL/min/1.73m2), Any other abnormality that, in the opinion of the investigator, will increase risk to the subject from participation, or interfere with interpretation of study data
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a history of mild elevation of hepatic transaminases, but specific ALT/AST values and other lab results are not provided to confirm compliance.

Recap: The patient does not meet inclusion criteria for patients with severe insulin resistance (no evidence of hyperinsulinemia, high insulin requirement, or relevant phenotypic features) or healthy controls (has diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, and coronary artery disease). Exclusion criteria for Cohort 1 are violated due to diabetes and metformin use. Cohort 2 is excluded due to HbA1c >5.7%.
